Scene/backdrop: an elevated contemporary diner at night with glossy cherry-red banquettes, deep-blue glazed tile, stainless-steel edging and a circular window overlooking blurred city lights; no signage or readable menus. Subject: one beautiful adult Middle Eastern woman, fully clothed in a powder-pink high-neck satin blouse with long sleeves, tailored navy culottes and closed red shoes; seated upright on a fixed chrome stool, turning the stool slightly with one foot while both hands rest naturally on the counter edge, amused direct expression. Style/medium: polished cinematic fashion editorial balancing diner charm with fine-dining restraint, realistic reflective surfaces and complexion. Composition/framing: vertical 2:3, full seated figure including feet, slightly high camera angle, circular window echoes the stool. Lighting/mood: controlled one-light hard flash softened by blue ambient glow, lively and sophisticated. Color palette: cherry red, deep blue, powder pink, chrome and navy. Constraints: one unmistakably adult woman, tasteful and nonsexual, opaque clothing, plausible seated anatomy and hands, no text, logo, watermark, brand, celebrity likeness, or imitation of any living artist.
